text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah, as expected, the breeze caught at high altitudes is even more wonderfully cool and refreshing...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I didn't know there was
such a tall building in town.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...If I were to catch the wind up on that tall building,
would I be able to feel the serene breeze even more...?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I came all the way here,
but the window isn't open, is it...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Is there really no way out of here?
Maybe I should ask around...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me. I'd like to go outside,
what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Employee
text_block_list.text:
When leaving, please use the
exit elevator over there.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. I'd just like to feel the wind outside the observation deck.
Is there an exit around here somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Employee
text_block_list.text:
Outside...?
If you wish, there are stairs leading outside, but...
um, the wind is terribly strong, you know?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really?
Thank you so much for the wonderful information...!

And so, Yamanin Zephyr bolted out
of the observation deck, but—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... What a powerful gust.
Only a place this high up could have winds like this...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: One day, I want to whip up a heavenly gale like that too...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "For that reason, I must not... forget this feeling."
Inspired by the high-altitude wind, Yamanin Zephyr's running grew noticeably sharper from that day on.
